plan.description: Recon and migration-planning agent for WebArena sites. Given a live local URL and its Docker image, probes the container and the running site to extract routes, DOM, copy, design tokens, and real seed data, then writes SOURCE.md, ROUTES.md, DESIGN.md, assets/, src/data/, and TODO.md.

dev.description: Frontend developer for WebArena to mock migrations. Rebuilds the source site as a self-contained React/Vite mock with route parity, real seed data, no database, no auth, and ?sid= session isolation.

playwright.description: Differential UI testing agent. Runs the mock alongside the live WebArena source, sweeps every route in ROUTES.md for cold-load and sid parity, tests every interactive element, and compares mock against source side by side. Writes TEST.md.

orchestrator.description: Loop orchestrator for WebArena migrations. Runs preflight on the source URL and Docker image, then coordinates plan, dev, audit, and playwright agents in rounds until route parity and the Definition of Done are met.

audit.description: Code audit agent. Audits migration parity (route drift, fabricated seed identifiers, external network calls, auth gates), UI completeness (dead handlers, stubs), and data pipeline integrity. Produces AUDIT.md and maintains SCHEMA.md.
